note: Current native operation scope is narrower than full overload coverage. Entries record actual adapter calls, not semantic equivalence of all overloads. Infrastructure tools have no standalone native API coverage.

operations.scope: Count getter; pattern adapter rejects count above 256; diagnostic count is separate.
Current zero-based index; output name validation is bounded, not durable identity.
Numeric 2D reference position; observed center in accepted fixture, not all shapes/builds.
Nonnegative finite area in mm2, bounded by result contract.
Bounded native record conversion; accepted Height/Width string layout, not outline vertices.
Simple straight polygon of 3-64 pairs converted to (float,float,0), no curves/holes. Diagnostic square has weaker count-only readback.
Unique name and fresh index/expected-name guard; create/copy plus naming is not atomic.
Relative 2D mm displacement; count/name/area/position readback; no complete topology/sewing guarantee.
Whole-piece relative 2D movement, not individual points or 3D placement.
One uniquely named piece, verified remaining name order; indices invalidate; no relationship restoration guarantee.

overload_policy: Arity matching is a candidate mapping only. Full official overload coverage remains not_established until argument semantics, types and acceptance scope are explicitly reviewed.
